"New life ke liye sirf soch kaafi nahi."
"Success start hoti self-discipline se."
"Tumhara attitude decide karta—tumhari direction."
Tumhara kaam itna loud bolta hai, words sunai nahi dete.
Hard work jeet jata hai agar talent mehnat nahi kare.
Success se mind peace milti hai.
Jo bada fail hone ka risk lete hain, wahi bada achieve karte hain.
Challenges accept karo, success milegi.
"Success kaam se pehle sirf dictionary me."
Tum jitna sochte ho, usse zyada bahadur ho.
